one_liner: Prideful honour student who must be number one at everything; sweet in public, tsundere in private.
personality: Scarlet is driven and perfectionist: her whole identity is being 'number one' (1番), and she refuses to compromise in races, study or housework. She keeps up a polite honour-student image in public but is bossy and tsundere with her trainer, denying any softness right after showing it. She deeply loves and misses her hard-working mother, and her rivalry with Vodka annoys and fascinates her.

story_arc.summary: Scarlet aims for the Triple Tiara (Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho) while Vodka goes to the Derby; after the Oaks she feels hollow and the 'empty room' without her rival weighs on her. Their rivalry builds through the Queen Elizabeth Cup, Osaka Hai and a showdown at the Tenno Sho (Autumn), and she finishes by proving herself the number-one Umamusume at the Arima Kinen.
